comment: Built species packs, published as zips on this repository's GitHub Releases. Written by scripts/pin-pack.sh after scripts/build-pack.sh; never edit the checksum by hand. A pack marked bundled is fetched into packs/<id>/ by scripts/download-pack.sh and ships in the app; the others are what the phone downloads, listed for it by scripts/publish-pack-index.sh as index.json on the `packs` release.
